species.name: Natterjack

dex.text: Runs rather than hops, and sings loud enough to annoy the whole dune. Yellow stripe down its back, so it can be seen coming, which is rather the point.
dex.fact: Natterjack toads have a bright yellow stripe down their backs, and they run rather than hop.

species.real: On a still spring night a chorus of male natterjacks can carry for well over a kilometre, which makes Britain's rarest toad its loudest amphibian.

species.name: Natterchoir

dex.text: Does not so much sing as hold a public meeting. In spring the whole dune joins in, whether it wants to or not.
dex.fact: A male natterjack's call can carry for over a mile on a warm spring night.

species.real: Natterjacks run in short bursts rather than hopping, which earned them the nickname 'the running toad', and they wear a thin yellow stripe down the back.
